caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden chair positioned at an angle, showing both the front and side. The chair features curved back legs and a slightly reclined, rounded backrest with carved details along its edges. The backrest has a decorative horizontal splat with intricate scrollwork and a central leaf motif. The seat is upholstered in a deep purple or violet fabric, contrasting with the reddish-brown wood of the frame. The front legs of the chair are elaborately carved to resemble animal legs, with scrolls at the top and terminating in detailed paw-like feet. The background is plain and beige, and the artist’s name, "ARTHUR JOHNSON," appears stamped or written in small letters in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Chair
